    static void init(int n) {

        ch[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            ch[i][0] = 1;

                result = (result * base) % MD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int l = sc.nextInt();

        init(n);

        long[] qq = new long[2 * n + 1];
